entities.summary: Guglielmo Epifani was an Italian trade unionist and politician. From 2002 to 2010, he was the General Secretary of the Italian General Confederation of Labour (CGIL), which was the biggest trade union in Europe. On 11 May 2013, Epifani was appointed secretary of the Democratic Party (PD).
